title: Analysis code for: Factors associated with the main route of household internet access in Borama District, Somaliland: a cross-sectional analysis of the BAHDA-2026 household survey
description:
Code that reproduces every table and figure of the manuscript and its supplement: a Stata file that derives the analysis file, Python scripts for the survey-weighted multinomial logistic regression, average marginal effects and fifteen sensitivity analyses, an R cross-check (survey, svyVGAM), and the output tables and figures of the reported run.

The BAHDA-2026 household microdata are not included. They are released by the Directorate of Research Strategy, Development and Performance, Amoud University, under its data access procedure.
